name: Equip
why: A capability a session needs, from Anthropic's plugins to a lean session that loads only what it uses
ideal: Plugins come from Anthropic's marketplaces or reviewed directory, Anthropic's replace custom copies, each repo enables its own, and unused or stale ones go.

sources.title: Claude Code: plugin security and trust
Claude Code: measure plugin cost and usage

steps.name: Source
steps.rule: Install from Anthropic's official marketplaces or its reviewed directory; anything else needs a named reason.

steps.name: Swap
steps.rule: A custom skill, agent, hook or plugin gives way to the Anthropic one that does the same job.

steps.name: Scope
steps.rule: Domain plugins are enabled in the repos that use them, so every session lists only its own.

steps.name: Connect
steps.rule: Every connector a session lists is signed in and ready before the first prompt.

steps.name: Use
steps.rule: Every enabled plugin is called within the account's recent sessions; one that is not comes off.

steps.name: Prune
steps.rule: Turned-off, orphaned, delisted and long-unmaintained installs are uninstalled.
